summary_markdown:
The dashboard release was planned to be split into two parts: 1) Real time data and Lithuania requests, and 2) Metrics, new impression model, and 2D lidar metrics. The real-time map functionality is considered critical for sales efforts and was activated for all clients after performance improvements were implemented.

A key issue identified was that not all sensors report real-time data, specifically noted in Estonia (no real-time map) and Lithuania (only 11 of 39 sensors visible). It was agreed that the sensor reporting bug needed fixing.

Discussions also covered content for the dashboard, including adding images for other countries and providing descriptions for metrics like 'Active devices', 'total traffic flow', and 'Reach'. The team decided on a release date (Thursday) and spent time discussing the confusing version numbering system for future releases, concluding that a special 'release notes version number' might be necessary.
decisions: The dashboard release will be split into two parts: Real time data/Lithuania requests and Metrics/Impression model/Lidar metrics.
Real-time map functionality was activated for all clients.
A bug causing some sensors not to report real-time data (e.g., Estonia, Lithuania) needs fixing.
The release announcement date is set for Thursday.
action_items: Fix the sensor reporting bug so all sensors provide real-time data across countries.
Add images and descriptions for metrics in other countries/sections.
Determine a standardized version numbering system for future releases to avoid confusion between firmware and dashboard versions.
